title: AI governance
summary: Connect AI inventories, NIST AI RMF and Generative AI Profile mapping, evaluation evidence, human review gates and post-deployment drift/change review to release decisions.
outcome: Govern AI use cases from discovery and classification through evaluation, deployment authorization, monitoring, and retirement.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: AI may assist drafting but cannot approve its own deployment
Legal classification remains reviewable
Material model changes require reassessment

title: Executive risk
summary: Trace executive priorities through likelihood, impact, source flags and accountable treatment decisions.
outcome: Convert traceable assurance signals into appetite breaches, KRI trends, treatment decisions, and board-ready accountability.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: No fake precision in risk scoring
Every metric links to a source and definition
Board decisions remain human-owned

title: AI transparency
summary: Review EU AI Act Article 50 disclosure, synthetic-content marking and oversight evidence against explicit technical readiness gates and manual legal review.
outcome: Operate product gates for AI-interaction disclosures, synthetic-output marking, deepfake disclosure, exceptions, and evidence retention.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: Applicability and exceptions require legal review
Technical marking must be tested, not asserted
Accessibility is part of disclosure effectiveness

title: Shadow AI governance
summary: Triage AI destinations using approval and data-classification metadata with transparent policy candidates.
outcome: Discover AI usage, classify destinations and prompt data, enforce egress policy, and manage justified exceptions.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: Do not retain raw prompts by default
Use data minimization and access controls
Employee monitoring requires privacy and labor-law review

title: Third-party risk
summary: Vet SaaS, LLM and external AI vendors: connect intake, data-use and training/retention terms, subprocessors, upstream dependencies and assurance evidence to documented risk decisions.
outcome: Select proportionate vendor due diligence from service, data, access, AI, location, criticality, and dependency context.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: No approval based only on an LLM summary
Evidence confidence must be explicit
Critical decisions require named human approval

title: Processor governance
summary: Surface processor DPA and transfer-review gaps alongside dependency records and human rationale.
outcome: Model controller, processor, subprocessor, processing, transfer, obligation, evidence, and change events as a reviewable relationship graph.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: Contract interpretation remains legal review
Do not expose confidential agreements publicly
Record evidence and reviewer rationale for every conclusion

title: Audit readiness
summary: Separate evidence availability, expiry and recorded control-test outcomes in one reviewable register.
outcome: Execute repeatable test procedures and preserve observations, hashes, results, exceptions, and POA&M records in machine-readable form.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: Automation does not replace the independent auditor
Failures and collection errors are distinct
Evidence custody and timestamps must be preserved

title: Continuous assurance
summary: Track control drift, evidence exceptions, expiry and retest ownership across the connected governance workspace.
outcome: Orchestrate collectors, evidence normalization, policy decisions, drift, finding lifecycle, SLA, retest, and immutable snapshots across the other nine modules.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: ERROR is never treated as FAIL or PASS
Evidence is hashed before release
Public telemetry is sanitized
Automatic code rewriting is prohibited in production

title: Customer assurance
summary: Connect customer claims to control IDs, dated evidence and named reviewers before drafting an assurance response.
outcome: Turn customer claims into a traceable claim-control-evidence graph with freshness and exception states.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: Never claim certification or an audit opinion
Redact confidential evidence from public outputs
Route contractual interpretation to MANUAL_REVIEW

title: Security questionnaires
summary: Pair editable procurement questions with bounded control-status drafts and evidence provenance.
outcome: Normalize customer questions, retrieve current evidence, draft bounded answers, and route unsupported claims for approval.
evidenceBasis: Method, source records & decision outputs
guardrails: Never fabricate a control or certification
NO_CURRENT_EVIDENCE is an acceptable result
Legal and contractual claims require approval
